item.description:
Vitrine now draws in the macOS 26 design: Liquid Glass materials, the round traffic lights, and the system controls that come with them. Earlier builds asked macOS for the previous look by mistake.
Everything you add goes through the plus. The separate link button is gone — it opened the same panel, whose first field is already waiting for a link.
Finding things moved to the top right and the library to the bottom left, each on its own rather than sharing one pill with the board's name.
Motion that was missing: chrome now steps aside for the inspector instead of jumping, the tool dock presses under the pointer like every other control, a download appearing or finishing no longer resizes the board bar in one frame, and a summoned panel — including ⌘K — arrives rather than appearing from nowhere. Reduce Motion removes all of it.
Apple Silicon and macOS 15 or newer. This beta is signed but not notarized.

Check for Updates is now available in the Vitrine menu. Install this first Sparkle-enabled beta with the curl installer; subsequent versions can update in the app.
